title: Organizer creates a Round Robin
description: Create a Round Robin end-to-end: pick the format, select players one by one (with a note on repeating), finalize, and open the new tournament page.

steps.title: Organizer on Players
steps.body: Organizers see + Tournament. The tutorial DB includes a roster of demo members so selection looks populated.

steps.title: Start a tournament
steps.body: Open the type modal. You will choose a format before naming and selecting players.

steps.title: Tournament type modal
steps.body: Formats include Round Robin, Playoff, Multi RR, Preliminary compounds, and Swiss. Pre-registration can be enabled here too.

steps.title: Choose Round Robin
steps.body: Select Round Robin for a single-table all-play-all event.

steps.title: Round Robin selected
steps.body: The selected format is highlighted. Optionally set a name, then continue to player selection.

steps.title: Continue to players
steps.body: Advance to the shared player picker used by every format.

steps.title: Player selection
steps.body: Each row has a checkbox. You build the field by selecting members one at a time.
steps.resultNote: Wizard moved to the player selection step.

steps.title: Select a player
steps.body: Check one member to add them to the tournament roster.

steps.title: One player included
steps.body: That member is now counted in the selection total. Round Robin still needs more players before you can continue.
steps.resultNote: First checkbox applied; selection count increased by one.

steps.title: More selections work the same
steps.body: You can check several more players the same way. The next screen skips those repeated clicks and shows the roster after a few similar selections.

steps.title: Roster filled in
steps.body: After repeating the selection, several members are checked and the Continue control becomes available.
steps.resultNote: Multiple players selected behind the scenes to show the completed roster.

steps.title: Continue to finalize
steps.body: When the roster meets the format minimum, continue into the Round Robin confirmation step.

steps.title: Confirm tournament
steps.body: Review the selected players, optionally split into multiple events, then create the Round Robin.
steps.resultNote: Confirmation panel lists the roster and Create Tournament.

steps.title: Create the tournament
steps.body: Finalize creation. The app opens the new tournament page when it succeeds.

steps.title: Tournament page
steps.body: You land on the new Round Robin with the selected participants already present — ready for day-of tools and scoring.
steps.resultNote: Create Tournament succeeded; detail page shows the active event.
